desc:
TAKE IT WITH YOU: Cinnamon Toast Crunch individual cereal cup is great to grab and go; Enjoy it as a part of breakfast; Pack one for an after school snack, a treat in the car, or anytime you need a tasty snack on the move

MADE WITH REAL CINNAMON: Crispy cereal squares made from whole wheat and rice, blasted with epic cinnamon sugar CINNADUST

WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving provides 22g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) and is an excellent source of vitamin D; Made without high fructose corn syrup or artificial flavors

BREAKFAST FOOD OR SNACK: Delicious with or without milk; This yummy cereal sparks smiles every time for kids and adults and makes an ideal pantry staple

CONTAINS: Twelve single serve plastic cups of crunchy Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Breakfast Cereal, Cinnamon Sugar Squares, 2 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Made with Whole Grain

Each crispy square is crafted with whole grain wheat and rice for added fiber and nutrition.

Iconic “Cinnadust” Flavor

Coated in the signature blend of cinnamon and sugar for a bold, sweet-spicy taste that stands out.

Ready-to-Eat Convenience

Comes in a 2 oz single-serve bowl—perfect for grab-and-go breakfasts or quick snacks.

Fortified with Essential Nutrients

Includes 12 key vitamins and minerals like Vitamin D, Iron, and B vitamins to support a balanced diet.

No Artificial Flavors

Delivers great taste using real cinnamon and no artificial flavoring.

Benefits

Crave-Worthy Taste

Loved by both kids and adults for its deliciously sweet and crunchy bite.

Nutritious Start to the Day

Combines flavor and function, offering whole grains and essential nutrients in one easy bowl.

Portable and Mess-Free

Pre-portioned packaging makes it ideal for school lunches, work snacks, or travel.

Low in Saturated Fat

Contains 0g of saturated fat and no cholesterol, supporting a heart-smart lifestyle.

Supports Daily Wellness

With added vitamins and minerals, it helps fill nutritional gaps in a fun and tasty way.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Rice Flour, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Dextrose, Salt, Cinnamon, Trisodium Phosphate, Soy Lecithin, Caramel Color, Rosemary Extract. BHT Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
